arms.full_fedhad: E_full(H_k), eta_k = max(eta_min, eta_base / (1 + lambda_eta H_k))
arms.inv: E_full(H_k), FedHAD multiset of eta_k re-assigned in inverse order of H_k among clients with data (largest H_k -> largest eta); ties by client index; clients without data keep their own rate
arms.lr_only_matched: E_fixed of Section 6.10 (ablation_policy.build_allocation), eta_k of FedHAD
arms.u1: E_fixed, uniform eta_bar computed with tau_k from E_fixed
arms.u2: E_full(H_k), uniform eta_bar computed with tau_k from E_full
arms.u2_arith: E_full(H_k), uniform eta = arithmetic mean of eta_k over clients with data

classification_rule.1: Holm p < 0.05 and the whole 95% bootstrap CI above 0
classification_rule.2: neither 1 nor 3, and the whole 90% bootstrap CI inside (-delta, +delta) (TOST at 5%); the two one-sided Wilcoxon p-values against -delta and +delta are reported
classification_rule.3: Holm p < 0.05 and the whole 95% bootstrap CI below 0
classification_rule.4: any other case: inconclusive; report the 90% CI half-width and the number of seeds that would fit it in the margin by simple extrapolation from the SD of the paired differences
classification_rule.applies_to: each contrast, separately at each alpha, mechanically
classification_rule.secondary_role: supporting evidence only, never a substitute for the primary

empty_clients: clients without samples do not enter eta_bar and do not train, as in Section 6.10; primary analysis includes all 30 seeds; sensitivity analysis excludes seeds with an empty client

eta_bar_definitions.arithmetic: mean_k eta_k over clients with data (arm u2_arith)
eta_bar_definitions.eta_k_source: the rates FedHAD produces on that partition
eta_bar_definitions.primary: sum_k p_k eta_k tau_k / sum_k p_k tau_k (clients with data)
eta_bar_definitions.tau_weighted: sum_k eta_k tau_k / sum_k tau_k (recorded, sensitivity)

holm_families.primary: Full - U2 alone, separately at each alpha (Holm-adjusted p equals raw p)
holm_families.secondary: the three secondary contrasts, one family at each alpha

hypotheses.outcome_3: uniform learning rate superior (U2 > Full FedHAD)
hypotheses.outcome_4: inconclusive (none of the above by the rule below)

notation.tau_k: E_k * floor(n_k_train / 32), optimizer steps per round

outcome: final centralized test accuracy after the last round, in percentage points
question: Does assigning the local learning rate according to the heterogeneity score H_k produce a different final accuracy from giving every client one uniform learning rate with the same aggregate first-order aggressiveness?

substrate.initialization: common checkpoint per seed, SHA-256 verified (results_reviewer_r2_checkpoints)
substrate.stochastic_trajectory: worker seeding per (seed, client, round), identical across arms

test: paired two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank over seeds
title: LR-uniform control battery for FedHAD (Section 6.10 substrate)
